# Legacy observations: T5 drawing and shape presets (local probe, 2026-10-05)

Captured by the `legacy_drawing_capture` probe: [`clip_capture.cpp`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/clip_capture.cpp) built with `PROBE_DRAWING` (target in [`tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt)), run on the cases in [`inputs/drawing-cases.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/inputs/drawing-cases.txt). On top of what T4's `legacy_clip_capture` compiles and copies ([local-t4-clip-20261005](../local-t4-clip-20261005/README.md): legacy `HikariSub/VisualClipRect.cpp` and `HikariSub/VisualClips.cpp` at `20d647c4` unchanged, with the Visuals, TagFindReplace, EditBox and config.cpp definitions they use), [`extract_functions.py`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/extract_functions.py) copies these out of their files unchanged: the classes `ShapesSetting` and `Shapes` (VisualDrawingShapes.h); the corner enum, `LoadSettings`, `GetNames`, `SaveSettings` and every `Shapes` member (`OnMouseEvent`, `DrawVisual`, `SetShape`, `GetVisual`, `SetScale`, `HitTest`, `SortPoints`, `SetDrawingScale`, `SetSquareShape`, `PointToVideo`, `PointToSubtitles`, `CalcDrawingAnchor`) from VisualDrawingShapes.cpp; the classes `TagData` and `ParseData` (SubsDialogue.h); `TagData`'s and `ParseData`'s members, `Dialogue::ClearParse`, `GetDefaultPosition` and `ParseTags` (SubsDialogue.cpp); `Styles::GetScaleXDouble` and `GetScaleYDouble` (styles.cpp). The `ShapesEdition` dialog is not run (its actions are ported one to one and tested without a capture).

Stand-ins ([`tools/legacy-capture/clip/`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/clip)) besides T4's: `VideoToolbar::GetShapesSettings` / `SetShapesSettings` as VideoToolbar.h:331-339; the Config folder's `ShapesSettings.txt` kept in memory (`OpenWrite` creating or truncating it, `FileOpen` dropping the BOM as wxConvAuto does, `PartFileWrite` writing the BOM first); the video toolbar's shape list (`shapeListSelection`, `ChangeTool(GetItemToggled())` as VideoToolbar.cpp:516-553 queues it) and its six buttons (`VectorItem(false)`); the video's time (`VideoBox::Tell`); the Style's alignment, margins, angle and scale; the renderer's line and device so that `DrawVisual` runs after the set-up and after every event, as legacy's `Draw` did (Visuals.cpp:504-529, without the warning), which is where a `\move` drawing's position follows the time (VisualClips.cpp:117-121). The drawing calls themselves (`DrawRect`, `DrawDashedLine`, the D3DX line) draw nothing.

Built locally with GCC 16.2.1 and the distribution's wxWidgets 3.2.11 (wxGTK). Run:

```
cmake -S tools/legacy-capture -B <dir> -DLEGACY_SOURCE=<checkout at 20d647c4> -DWX_CONFIG=$(which wx-config)
cmake --build <dir> --target legacy_drawing_capture
<dir>/legacy_drawing_capture < tools/legacy-capture/inputs/drawing-cases.txt > observations.jsonl
```

`observations.jsonl` holds one line per `dump` (99, in 49 cases) with T4's fields (every Line's text and translation, the Line editor's text, the history and the steps that changed a text, resets, bells and message boxes, every point, `GetVisual`'s text, `vectorScale`, the mode, the grabbed point, the coefficients, the selection box) and, for the drawing, `drawing`: `_x`, `_y`, the scale, `\an`, `frz`, `org`, the seven `moveValues`, the shape list's selection, `Shapes::shape`, the shape rectangle (`drawingRectangle`), whether it shows, `shapeScale`, `shapeSize`, the grabbed edge or corner, `diffs`, the shape's points; then `presets` (VideoToolbar's list: name, shape, mode, scaling mode) and `file` (Config/ShapesSettings.txt as written, when it exists). sha256 `ba68864d893dce8db3264c4f345bfbe66b9b1902b4d0e08c2d9d0f3dc9bac585`. The clip probe built from the same sources still gives T4's capture byte for byte (sha256 `9da386e0dafc70a41674dc93190a567eadb9f46032d33dc1b2b3ee33b7ff2764`).

The cases (script 1920x1080 on a 640x360 video). Free drawing: points added to a Line without a drawing; a drawing read with \an7, the default \an2 and \an5 with fractional numbers; \p2; \fscx / \fscy; the Style's scale and angle; \frz; \frz with \org and \an5; \move, and a \move at a later time; no position (the margins and the Style's); \an9 without a position; bare text; an empty Line; text around the drawing; a second \p tag; \p0 only; Bézier and B-spline points; the keys with Shift (a tenth); a selection box moved; points removed; the wheel over the six buttons; a separate point; three Lines selected; TLMode; a zoom; a pillarbox. Shape presets: legacy's defaults (the rectangle); the circle keeping its proportions; a rectangle's edge, corner and inside dragged and a new one outside it; a drag up and left; a rectangle too narrow and a click inside the shown one; every alignment; \an3 without a position; a drawing replaced; \p2 and \fscx; a file with other modes and the "Changing scale" scaling mode; "Changing scale" on a Line with \fscx / \fscy, without them and with longer values; a file with malformed lines (no "Shape: ", missing fields, a mode that does not read, runs of ";", blanks); switching shapes and back to "Choose"; a click and a double click without a drag; a right-button release; three Lines; a zoom; TLMode; another active Line.

## Compared with the rewrite

`DrawingCapture.ReplaysTheLegacyProbe` (`hikari_application_visual_drawing_tests`) sets every case up through `visual::VideoView` (checking the video rectangle and zoom the probe ran with), replays it through `visual::DrawingTool` with the presets the case's file gives, and compares every dump: the committed texts, the Line editor's text during a gesture on one Line (the staged text), the steps that changed a text and their name ("Visual vector drawing tool", legacy's VISUAL_DRAWING), the bells and notices, every point and its selection, the body, the \p scale, the mode, the selection box, the coefficients, the drawing's position, scale, alignment, rotation, \org and \move values, the shape list's selection, the shape, its rectangle, scale, size, grab and points, the presets held and the file written, float for float. No case differs.

One field is compared only in part: legacy's `moveValues` is never initialised (`double moveValues[7]` in Visuals.h:160; neither `Visuals::Visuals` nor `DrawingAndClip`'s or `Shapes`' constructors set it) and `GetPosnScale` writes only the values a \pos or \move gives (`tbl[6]` of them). The capture's other values are whatever the probe's previous case left in that memory (for example `draw-no-position` shows the 300, 300, 900, 600 of the `\move` case before it), so the replay compares the first `tbl[6]` of the four positions; the rewrite starts the table at zero.

Legacy behaviour the capture shows, kept: a drawing is written with \p1, a \pos and an \an added when missing, plain text after a block put in a block of its own and a "{\p0}" after a drawing that ends the text; \p0 sets the tool's \p scale to 0 (GetPosnScale, Visuals.cpp:699), a later positive \p tag replaces it; the drawing read is the first after the first tag; a \move drawing's points follow the video's time; a shape is written one unit right and down of its rectangle and scaled into it, the circle and rounded squares keeping their proportions ("Preserve aspect ratio", Shift toggling it); "Changing scale" (reachable only from the file: the dialog's choice is disabled) replaces the Line's \fscx and \fscy in place when their new values are no longer than the old (`shapes-change-scale-existing-tags`), but when it adds them or a value grows, Shapes::SetScale's `diff` (old length minus new, VisualDrawingShapes.cpp:612-622) moves the drawing's recorded place the wrong way (VisualClips.cpp:640-643), so the next sample writes the drawing into the tags and garbles the Line (`shapes-change-scale-new-tags` dump 2, `shapes-change-scale-longer-tags` dump 1: "{\fscy12m 1 1 l 301 1 301 181 1 1810)}m 1 1 ...") — kept, reported as a candidate departure; a click without a drag writes nothing, a drag too narrow writes an empty drawing; malformed preset lines are skipped and runs of ";" count as one.
